review_evidence: README identifies Parse.lean as an llparse-based protocol parser generator that emits Lean and C parsers.
A complete declaration scan over the 14 primary Lean files found 169 implementation declarations but zero theorem, lemma, axiom or proposition-example declarations.
The source implements parser-generation syntax, state machines and code generation; it does not provide an independent proved parser specification or formal semantics.

source_action.content_invariant: All 14 primary Lean files are parser-generator implementation, syntax/state-machine infrastructure or code-generation support. They contain no theorem/lemma/axiom/example propositions and no independent proved protocol/parser semantics, so retirement removes no mathematical theorem/proof or formal specification corpus.
